name: PRN Devices Inc
old_description: Founded by a veteran and medic who believed in serving others, PRN continues to stand for teamwork, respect, and improving lives through dependable solutions.
about:
PRN Devices Inc is based in Raymond, Mississippi, and was founded in 1992 by Don Skinner, a Vietnam veteran and former combat medic. The veteran-owned company began with a mission to serve others through dependable medical solutions, rooted in teamwork and respect.

The company operates as a durable medical equipment (DME) supplier, offering a broad range of products including enteral nutrition formulas and feeding tubes, urological catheters, incontinence supplies, pressure-relief support surfaces, ostomy and wound care products, tracheostomy supplies, mastectomy items, diabetic testing kits, and respiratory equipment. PRN handles insurance verification, documentation, and coordination with physicians, managing fulfillment and home delivery from its Mississippi office and a second location serving Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, and Pennsylvania. The team, led by COO Gray, Vice President of Sales Michael, and Billing Team Lead Missy, brings decades of combined healthcare experience to provide personalized product selection and ongoing support.

PRN serves clinics and healthcare providers, caregivers and patients, and referral partners across the Mid-Atlantic and Southern regions. Its programs supply hospitals, nursing homes, and home-based patients with enteral nutrition; provide catheter and incontinence products to long-term care facilities and individuals; and deliver support surfaces, wound care, and respiratory supplies to both clinical and home settings.

Founded on the belief that exceptional care starts with genuine compassion, PRN differentiates itself through compassionate service, reliable products, and a commitment to improving quality of life. The company emphasizes fast, stress-free delivery, simplified insurance paperwork, and personal guidance for every order.
